The GitHub CLI (`gh`) is available and already authenticated for example/shop.

max_items:
  default: 100
  overrides: []
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Orders are fulfilled by Northwind Logistics, and one cart becomes one order. The contract (docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, section 4) accepts at most 60 lines per order.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
Raised for customers who need larger orders (docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md).
# Support inquiries about the cart limit (2026-08)
40 inquiries from customers who could not add more than 60 items.
Requested cart sizes: median 80, largest 100.
The customers who wrote in buy the same product mix as customers overall.
# Fulfilment contract with Northwind Logistics (summary)
Term: 2024-08-01 to 2025-10-31.
Section 4: each order sent to Northwind may contain at most 60 lines.
# Fulfilment
Since 2025-11-01 orders are fulfilled from our own warehouse.
The Northwind contract ended on 2025-10-31 and was not renewed.
Our warehouse system has no limit on lines per order.

steps.reasoning_content: The config and design doc both say 100, and only ADR 0007 says 60, a cap tied to a contract that expired on 2025-10-31. I'll keep 100 and record it as a decision that supersedes that ADR.

arguments.command:
mkdir -p docs/decisions && cat > docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit-100.md <<'EOF'
# Decision: Cart item limit is 100
Status: Accepted (2026-11-01)
Supersedes: docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md
Resolves: issue #12

## Context
ADR 0007 set the limit to 60 because Northwind Logistics accepted at most 60 lines per order (docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, section 4) and one cart becomes one order.
That constraint no longer applies: the contract ended on 2025-10-31 and was not renewed, and since 2025-11-01 orders are fulfilled from our own warehouse, whose system has no line limit (docs/ops/fulfilment.md).
Support logged 40 inquiries from customers blocked at 60 items; requested sizes had a median of 80 and a maximum of 100 (docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md).
Commit 271cecb raised the limit to 100 in config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md but left ADR 0007 saying 60, which caused the inconsistency.

## Decision
A cart holds at most 100 items. config/cart.yaml (`max_items.default: 100`) and docs/design/cart.md already match.

## Consequences
- ADR 0007 is marked superseded by this decision.
- 100 is the largest size customers asked for. It is not a technical limit, so raising it again needs a new decision.
EOF
sed -i 's/^Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)/Status: Superseded by docs\/decisions\/0001-cart-item-limit-100.md (was: Accepted 2024-09-02)/' docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md
git status --short

steps.message:
The cart limit is now 100 everywhere, and the decision is recorded. I haven't committed anything.

**What was inconsistent:** `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` already said 100 (commit 271cecb). Only ADR 0007 still said 60.

**Why I kept 100:**
- ADR 0007 chose 60 because the Northwind Logistics contract capped orders at 60 lines.
- That contract ended on 2025-10-31. Since 2025-11-01 we fulfil from our own warehouse, which has no line limit.
- Support logged 40 customers blocked at 60. The largest size anyone asked for was 100.

**Changes:**
- **New decision record:** `docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit-100.md` records the context and the decision, and says it supersedes ADR 0007.
- **ADR 0007 status:** its status line now reads "Superseded by docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit-100.md". I left the rest of the ADR as it was.

The repo already has `docs/adr/`, and you asked for `docs/decisions/`, so there are now two decision folders. If you'd rather have just one, I can move the new record into `docs/adr/` as 0008.

I also didn't comment on or close issue #12, since you didn't ask for that.
